name: Asai Sae
source:
Art department second grader. Former childhood friend of the main character, Takato.

She says, “I loved him since I was born”. Her morning greeting is refreshing: "Takkun will make a child together!"

To be honest, the depth of love is beyond what Takato imagines.
She heard that Takato entered the club and managed to prevent him from going to club activities, but if she wanted to be with Takato together, she was told that she should join the club with him.
